icicles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone winter icicle trim sprite for Buzzle cozy bee mobile game. Rounded friendly ice crystal tips, clear but not needle sharp. Ice is pale blue and cream, mild warm honey highlights along upper left edges, no dark saturated cyan. True transparent background, clean alpha, no cast shadow on ground, no text, no glow cloud, no detached snowflakes. Reference images are material/style references only, do not draw lantern or tree.
